target.statement: Average k-means loss for Smartigan on Fisher Iris with k=3 (79.23), compared to Hartigan (78.85) and Lloyd (96.88), averaged over 500 runs.

compute.basis: Iris is tiny (150x4); implementing Hartigan/Smartigan from the pseudocode and running 500 random-initialized trials is a few minutes of CPU time; no code is released, so the agent must write the algorithm itself.

blockers: No code released for the paper's own experiments (only a link to a different paper's repo for Table 4)
Must implement Hartigan and Smartigan from pseudocode; exact random initialization scheme not fully specified
title: An effective variant of the Hartigan $k$-means algorithm
